claim_boundary: fresh fixed-weight state collection for external diagnostic decoder tracking; no claim of Demian learning, adaptation, self-readout, routing control, or causal channel mechanism
support: All 64 binary histories are collected for each order, seed and checkpoint. The base-order final-symbol/log-odds-sign procedure allocates 32 train and 32 evaluation histories, paired across orders and checkpoints.
controls: Analytic latest-cue semantics and conditional train-label shuffle. No target-order states or evaluation histories fit a decoder, normalization, projection, translation, scale, or rotation.
novelty: Seeds 2094/2095/2194/2195, split97 and both reliability orders differ from the two prior matrix protocols; each order contains exactly two .95, two .75 and two .5 reliabilities.
decision_rule: For each delay2 and delay8 separately, orthogonal-tracked true-label R2 must exceed analytic latest-cue and matched shuffled-label R2 in all 12 seed-by-projection cells for a within-order confirmation. Cross-order scores are secondary strict portability: the base-trained tracker is applied unchanged.
